metas.name: Batman Begins
metas.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

metas.name: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
metas.description: A bounty-hunting scam joins two men in an uneasy alliance against a third in a race to find a fortune in gold buried in a remote cemetery.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
metas.description: After the Kingsman's headquarters is destroyed and the world is held hostage, an allied spy organization in the United States is discovered. These two elite secret agencies must band together to defeat a common enemy.

metas.name: The Amateur
metas.description: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a decoder takes matters into his own hands.

metas.name: Rocky
metas.description: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

metas.name: The Butterfly Effect
metas.description: A boy suffers blackouts during traumatic events, but in college he finds a way to travel back in time to those moments and alter the course of his life.

metas.name: Pearl Harbor
metas.description: Two lifelong friends and a beautiful nurse are caught up in the horror of an infamous Sunday morning in 1941.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: The Running Man
metas.description: A man joins a game show in which contestants, allowed to flee anywhere in the world, are pursued by "hunters" hired to kill them.

metas.name: Full Metal Jacket
metas.description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

metas.name: The Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends travel to a cabin in the woods, where they unknowingly release flesh-possessing demons.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All at Once
metas.description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

metas.name: Hacksaw Ridge
metas.description: World War II American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, serving during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first man in American history to receive the Medal of Honor without firing a shot.

metas.name: Barry Lyndon
metas.description: An Irish rogue wins the heart of a rich widow and assumes her dead husband's aristocratic position in 18th-century England.

metas.name: Iron Man
metas.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

metas.name: The Warriors
metas.description: Members of a street gang known as the Warriors must fight their way from the Bronx to their home turf on Coney Island when they are falsely accused of assassinating a respected gang leader.

metas.name: Crimson Peak
metas.description: A new bride investigates ghostly visions at a remote gothic mansion that holds dark secrets.

metas.name: The Gift
metas.description: A married couple, Simon and Robyn, run into Gordo, an old classmate. Things take a turn when Gordo begins to drop in unannounced at their house and inundates them with mysterious gifts.

metas.name: Anyone But You
metas.description: After an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's fiery attraction turns ice-cold--until they find themselves unexpectedly reunited at a wedding in Australia. So they do what any two mature adults would do: pretend to be a couple.

metas.name: What's Your Number?
metas.description: A woman looks back at the past nineteen men she's had relationships with in her life and wonders if one of them might be her one true love.

metas.name: Top Gun
metas.description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds ...

metas.name: MaXXXine
metas.description: In 1980s Hollywood, adult film star and aspiring actress Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

metas.name: Mother's Pride
metas.description: A comedy about a failing pub, a divided community and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A petty thief desperate for work muscles into the world of crime journalism and becomes the star of his own story as he blurs the line between observer and participant.

metas.name: La La Land
metas.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.

metas.name: Clue
metas.description: Six guests are anonymously invited to a strange mansion for dinner, but after their host is killed, they must cooperate with the staff to identify the murderer as the bodies pile up.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada
metas.description: An aspiring journalist starts working as an assistant to the cruel editor-in-chief of a high-fashion magazine.

metas.name: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
metas.description: A rain-soaked couple take refuge in the castle of a transvestite mad scientist from outer space who is about to unveil his greatest creation.

metas.name: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
metas.description: After waking from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A champion high school cheerleading squad discovers its previous captain stole all their best routines from an inner-city school and must scramble to compete at this year's championships.

metas.name: Hoppers
metas.description: A 19-year-old animal lover uses technology that places her consciousness into a robotic beaver to uncover mysteries within the animal world beyond her imagination.

metas.name: Risky Business
metas.description: A Chicago teenager is looking for fun at home while his parents are away, but the situation quickly gets out of hand.

metas.name: ParaNorman
metas.description: A misunderstood boy takes on ghosts, zombies and grown-ups to save his town from a centuries-old curse.

metas.name: Joker
metas.description: Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.

metas.name: The Hangover
metas.description: Three buddies wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas with no memory of the previous night and the bachelor missing. They must make their way around the city in order to find their friend in time for his wedding.

metas.name: Idiocracy
metas.description: Corporal Joe Bauers, a decidedly average American, is selected for a top-secret hibernation program but is forgotten and left to awaken to a future so incredibly moronic that he's easily the most intelligent person alive.

metas.name: Edge of Tomorrow
metas.description: A man fighting in a war against aliens must relive the same day every time he dies until he can find a way to stop their power source with the help of an elite soldier.

metas.name: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
metas.description: An advertising executive and ladies' man, to win a big campaign, bets that he can make a woman fall in love with him in 10 days.

metas.name: Smile 2
metas.description: About to embark on a world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her past.

metas.name: Saw
metas.description: Two men awaken to find themselves on the opposite sides of a dead body, each with specific instructions to kill the other, escape or face the consequences. These two are the latest contestants in Jigsaw's games.

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: A father fights fiercely against ruthless kidnappers to save his abducted daughter.

metas.name: The Shadow's Edge
metas.description: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

metas.name: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
metas.description: Hunt and the IMF pursue a dangerous AI called the Entity that's infiltrated global intelligence. With governments and a figure from his past in pursuit, Hunt races to stop it from forever changing the world.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A pair of underachieving cops are sent back to a local high school to blend in and bring down a synthetic drug ring.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
metas.description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins.

metas.name: Transformers
metas.description: An ancient struggle between two Cybertronian races, the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, comes to Earth, with a clue to the ultimate power held by a teenager.

metas.name: Train Dreams
metas.description: A logger leads a life of unexpected depth and beauty in the rapidly-changing America of the early 1900s.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: 25 years after the original Woodsboro killings, a new Ghostface begins targeting teens connected to the town's dark past, drawing the final 3 survivors of the first attack back once more.

metas.name: They Will Kill You
metas.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

metas.name: Margin Call
metas.description: Follows the key people at an investment bank over a 24-hour period during the early stages of the 2008 financial crisis.

metas.name: The Night House
metas.description: A widow begins to uncover her recently deceased husband's disturbing secrets.

metas.name: The Intouchables
metas.description: After he becomes a quadriplegic from a paragliding accident, an aristocrat hires a young man from the projects to be his caregiver.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: Basic Instinct
metas.description: A violent police detective investigates a brutal murder that might involve a manipulative and seductive novelist.

metas.name: Stand by Me
metas.description: A writer recounts a childhood journey with his friends to view the body of a boy who went missing in the woods.

metas.name: The Little Things
metas.description: A deputy sheriff and a sergeant search for a serial killer who's terrorizing Los Angeles.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A middle-aged husband's life changes dramatically when his wife asks him for a divorce. He seeks to rediscover his manhood with help from new acquaintance Jacob, who teaches him to pick up women at bars.

metas.name: The Descent
metas.description: A caving expedition goes horribly wrong when six explorers become trapped and ultimately pursued by a strange breed of predators.

metas.name: The Devil All the Time
metas.description: A cycle of generational trauma and religious fanaticism consumes rural Ohio and West Virginia, as a young man confronts the violent legacy of his father and the predatory sins of local authority figures.

metas.name: The Mist
metas.description: In the small town of Bridgton, Maine, people become trapped inside a supermarket after a mysterious mist envelops the town.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

metas.name: Avengers: Age of Ultron
metas.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: Sleepers
metas.description: A reporter and a District Attorney help childhood friends who killed a sadistic guard.

metas.name: Don't Worry Darling
metas.description: While her husband leaves home every day to work in a top secret facility, a young 1950s housewife begins to question her life when she notices strange behavior from the other wives in the neighborhood.

metas.name: Jason Bourne
metas.description: The CIA's most dangerous former operative is drawn out of hiding to uncover more explosive truths about his past.

metas.name: John Wick
metas.description: John Wick is a former hitman grieving the loss of his true love. When his home is broken into, robbed, and his dog killed, he is forced to return to action to exact revenge.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: The uneventful, aimless lives of a London electronics salesman and his layabout roommate are disrupted by the zombie apocalypse.

April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.

metas.name: Argo
metas.description: Acting under the cover of a Hollywood producer scouting a location for a science fiction film, a CIA agent launches a dangerous operation to rescue six Americans in Tehran during the U.S. hostage crisis in Iran in 1979.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
metas.description: Harry Potter finds himself competing in a hazardous tournament between rival schools of magic, but he is distracted by recurring nightmares.

metas.name: Fury
metas.description: A grizzled tank commander makes tough decisions as he and his crew fight their way across Germany in April, 1945.

metas.name: The Fly
metas.description: A botched experiment transmutes a man into a monstrous insect.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Lights Out
metas.description: A supernatural entity reemerges to terrorize a family when the lights go out at night.

metas.name: Late Night with the Devil
metas.description: A live television broadcast in 1977 goes horribly wrong, unleashing evil into the nation's living rooms.

metas.name: Legend
metas.description: Identical twin gangsters Ronald and Reginald Kray terrorize London during the 1960s.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: Journalist Mikael Blomkvist is aided by eccentric hacker Lisbeth Salander in his search for a woman who has been missing for 40 years.

metas.name: The Handmaiden
metas.description: In 1930s Korea, a girl is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress who lives a secluded life on a countryside estate. But the maid has a secret: She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler to help seduce the Lady and steal her ...

metas.name: Toy Story
metas.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: A wisecracking mercenary gets experimented on and becomes immortal yet hideously scarred, and sets out to track down the man who ruined his looks.

metas.name: Black Widow
metas.description: Natasha Romanoff confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises.

metas.name: Final Destination
metas.description: After getting a premonition about a plane crash on his school trip, Alex, a student, saves a few of his classmates. However, their situation gets complicated when death starts chasing them.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: The owner of an aging high-class hotel regales a writer with tales of serving as a lobby boy under an exceptional concierge in the hotel's glory years.

metas.name: Point Break
metas.description: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

metas.name: Ford v Ferrari
metas.description: American car designer Carroll Shelby and driver Ken Miles battle corporate interference and the laws of physics to build a revolutionary race car for Ford in order to defeat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1966.

metas.name: The Wailing
metas.description: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

metas.name: The Big Short
metas.description: Prior to the 2008 financial crisis, a group of investors bet against the US mortgage market and are stunned by the corruption they uncover through their research.

metas.name: Van Helsing
metas.description: The famed monster hunter is sent to Transylvania to stop Count Dracula, who is using Dr. Frankenstein's research and a werewolf for nefarious purposes.

metas.name: GoldenEye
metas.description: When a powerful secret defense system is stolen, James Bond is assigned to stop a Russian crime syndicate from using it.

metas.name: Your Name.
metas.description: Two teenagers, a city boy in Tokyo and a girl in rural Japan, mysteriously begin swapping bodies, forging a connection that sends them searching for one another.

metas.name: Captain America: The First Avenger
metas.description: Steve Rogers, a rejected military soldier, transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a "Super-Soldier serum". But being Captain America comes at a price as he attempts to take down a warmonger and a terrorist organiza...

metas.name: Interview with the Vampire: The Vampire Chronicles
metas.description: A vampire tells his epic life story: love, betrayal, loneliness, and hunger.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description: As his last assignment, a temporal agent is tasked to travel back in time and prevent a bomb attack in New York in 1975. The hunt, however, turns out to be beyond the bounds of possibility.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: A young boy and his little sister struggle to survive in Japan during World War II.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
metas.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

metas.name: From Dusk Till Dawn
metas.description: Two criminals and their hostages unknowingly seek temporary refuge in a truck stop populated by vampires, with chaotic results.
